verification_addenda.scope: focused Play-trigger visual and accessibility refinement
verification_addenda.evidence: Independent live-browser checks at 1280x800 and 390x844 proved visible [Play] copy, accessible name Play The Harmonic Seal, explicit control resets, quiet brass tertiary hierarchy, 46px height, smaller dimensions than peer actions, no overflow, visible hover/focus, focus entry and exact Escape return, and a no-JS display:none zero-size rendered box. Focused tests, build, axe, and diff check passed.

Independent live-browser and visual checks at 1280x800 and 390x844 proved exactly two navigation links in .atelier-actions; a separate immediately following data-backed invitation; visible Play The Harmonic Seal copy as its accessible name without aria-label; successful-mount-only reveal; no-JS and failed-mount display:none zero-size behavior; desktop max-38rem three-column treatment; mobile full-width own-row button; 46px target; no overflow; hover/focus and exact focus lifecycle; no new animation or prohibited capability. Focused tests, navigation, build, axe, and diff check passed.

acceptance_checks.then: exactly one modal dialog and backdrop exist; Play selects harmonic-seal, Wayfinder selects chart, and no nested dialog or focus trap exists
acceptance_checks.verify_method: DOM/integration test counts one modal dialog, exercises both triggers, and checks only the selected view is exposed and focusable

acceptance_checks.when: Back to chart, shared Close, Escape, and backdrop are used
acceptance_checks.then: Back switches view in place; the others close using current Wayfinder behavior and restore exact invoking focus
acceptance_checks.verify_method: browser test checks active element, inertness, visibility, and no second open/close cycle on Back

acceptance_checks.given: a modified folio, undo history, or reflection draft
acceptance_checks.when: chart/game switching or close/reopen occurs on the same document
acceptance_checks.then: the draft is preserved; navigation/reload resets it; no durable storage is used
acceptance_checks.verify_method: browser test compares state across switches/reopens, reloads for reset, and spies on localStorage, sessionStorage, and cookie writes

acceptance_checks.then: only itself and existing orthogonal neighbors toggle, without diagonal or edge wrapping
acceptance_checks.verify_method: deterministic tests assert center, edge, corner, and double-pulse behavior

acceptance_checks.then: they equal their targets in 2, 3, 4, and 5 pulses respectively
acceptance_checks.verify_method: data test validates 25 bits, exact rows, listed sequences, and final equality

acceptance_checks.when: a pulse other than row 3 column 3 is attempted, then the guided pulse is used
acceptance_checks.then: invalid input does not mutate; after the guide, row 2 column 4 must be inferred to complete
acceptance_checks.verify_method: interaction test checks board, history, guide, instruction, and completion

acceptance_checks.then: pulse input stops and explicit progression appears without score, timer, move count, par, hint, or solution
acceptance_checks.verify_method: DOM test completes every folio and scans visible and accessible text for forbidden UI

acceptance_checks.given: any pulse history including a completed folio
acceptance_checks.when: Undo, Restart folio, or Restart session is selected
acceptance_checks.then: undo is unlimited; folio restart restores its initial state; session restart clears game and reflection to Folio I
acceptance_checks.verify_method: state tests use more than 25 pulses, undo to origin, and assert reset scopes

acceptance_checks.given: any folio or completed Folio IV
acceptance_checks.when: End session or Share a reflection is selected
acceptance_checks.then: reflection appears explicitly, accepts Yes/Maybe/No and optional text, and is never transmitted or persisted
acceptance_checks.verify_method: browser/network test checks transition timing, zero network submission, preservation in memory, and reload reset

acceptance_checks.then: it exposes five rows, 25 named native buttons, one roving tabindex zero, bounded grid keys, and Enter/Space/pointer parity
acceptance_checks.verify_method: DOM/browser test exercises keys, boundaries, names, focus after rerender, and resulting states

acceptance_checks.when: focus, view, folio, status, or close transitions occur
acceptance_checks.then: focus remains in visible dialog controls, page is inert, announcements are concise, and close restores invoking focus
acceptance_checks.verify_method: browser assertions plus automated axe audit with zero serious or critical violations

acceptance_checks.when: the game opens and dynamic viewport changes
acceptance_checks.then: it fills the viewport, respects safe areas, prevents background scroll and horizontal clipping, and remains touch-usable
acceptance_checks.verify_method: responsive tests at 320x568, 390x844, and 568x320 inspect bounds, overflow, scroll ownership, and activation

acceptance_checks.given: 320x568 portrait and 568x320 landscape at 100 percent zoom
acceptance_checks.then: complete board and target are simultaneously legible in one snapshot and essential controls are horizontally unclipped
acceptance_checks.verify_method: checker reviews deterministic screenshots; any failure blocks for owner decision with no fallback substitution

acceptance_checks.given: color-vision variation, muted audio, or reduced-motion preference
acceptance_checks.then: state remains distinguishable through shape, text, focus, and status while nonessential motion is removed
acceptance_checks.verify_method: stylesheet and DOM assertions, reduced-motion browser run, and grayscale screenshot review

acceptance_checks.given: JavaScript is unavailable or a page lacks Play
acceptance_checks.then: no dead Play or script error appears, navigation fallback remains useful, and the game module exits safely
acceptance_checks.verify_method: no-JS check, representative console scan, production build, navigation/game tests, and npm run test:a11y-static

acceptance_checks.given: the implementation diff and built site
acceptance_checks.then: it stays in declared boundaries and contains no prohibited modal, canvas control, dependency, audio, analytics, randomness, network game call, or persistence
acceptance_checks.verify_method: checker diff review and targeted source/bundle scan record zero prohibited capability
